kurz: Thicken a soup or sauce with a mixture of egg yolk and cream without the yolk curdling.
bild_im_kopf: Like easing cold feet slowly into a warm bath instead of jumping in.
was_passiert: [[eigelb|Egg yolk]] thickens as it warms and binds the liquid. Added straight to hot soup, it curdles into strands at once. If it is first brought up to temperature with a little hot liquid, its temperature rises slowly and it thickens creamily.
schritte: Stir in a few spoonfuls of hot soup (tempering).
Add the mixture to the soup and take the pot off the heat.
Stir until it thickens slightly. Do not let it boil again.
